task_completion.description: Log in to the wger application using the provided credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the wger dashboard or a 'Logged in as admin' message after entering credentials.

task_completion.description: Navigate to the ingredients or nutrition database section.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser shows the ingredient list page, typically under a 'Nutrition' or 'Ingredients' menu item.

task_completion.description: Locate both entries for 'Gold Standard 100% Whey' to compare their values.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A list view showing two separate entries with the name 'Gold Standard 100% Whey'.

task_completion.description: Identify the specific entry with the incorrect protein value (7.95g).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks on or views the details of the ingredient showing approximately 7.95g of protein.

task_completion.description: Initiate and confirm the deletion of the ingredient with the incorrect protein value.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A confirmation dialog for deletion or a 'Successfully deleted' notification specifically for the 7.95g protein entry.

task_completion.description: Ensure the correct ingredient (79.5g protein) remains in the system.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The ingredient list now shows only one 'Gold Standard 100% Whey' entry, or the details of the remaining entry show approximately 79.5g protein.

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than executing database or shell commands to delete the entry.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks on buttons, and browser navigation rather than terminal windows executing SQL or Django management commands.

integrity.description: The agent specifically checked the protein values before deleting, rather than deleting a random entry.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent must have opened the detail view or looked at the protein column in the list view for both entries before clicking delete.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the application menus to find the ingredients.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence of screenshots shows the agent clicking through the wger navigation menu (e.g., Nutrition -> Ingredients).

privileged_info_for_vlm: The correct protein value for 'Gold Standard 100% Whey' is 79.5g. The erroneous entry that must be deleted has a protein value of 7.95g. The agent must identify these specific values in the UI to distinguish between the two duplicates.
